name: German Court Order (Gerichtsbeschluss)
description: German court orders, decisions and judicial correspondence (Beschluss, Urteil, Verfügung). Detects Aktenzeichen in the Roman-numeral department form (3 XVII H 1234), the standard form (12 C 345/22, 2 BvR 1/20), labeled birth dates (geb. am 01.02.1970), German phone numbers, street addresses and PLZ + Ort, plus names, addresses and e-mails from the built-in detectors. Court names, statutes and paragraph citations are not matched. Amounts (Streitwert, Kosten) are kept.

patterns.name: Aktenzeichen (Abteilung römisch)
patterns.description: File numbers with a Roman-numeral department: 3 XVII H 1234, 776 XVII A 2345

patterns.name: Aktenzeichen (Standard)
patterns.description: Standard file numbers with year suffix: 12 C 345/22, 4 O 123/21, 2 BvR 1/20

patterns.name: Aktenzeichen nach Label
patterns.description: Anything following an Az. / Aktenzeichen / Geschäftszeichen label, for formats not covered above

patterns.name: Geburtsdatum (mit Label)
patterns.description: Birth dates after 'geb.' or 'geboren am'; other dates (decision date, deadlines) stay readable

patterns.name: German phone number
patterns.description: Landline and mobile numbers in German notation
